data.name: Gaffar
data.gender_notes: Gaffar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gaffar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Gopa', meaning protector or cowherd. It is a name that signifies purity, trustworthiness, and honesty. It is a strong and wise name, often given to boys who are expected to be reliable and steadfast in their actions. The name Gaffar carries the meaning “Pure, Trustworthy, Honest” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Gaffar usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, trustworthy, honest and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gaffar is a name with deep spiritual significance. It represents the divine qualities of purity, truthfulness, and steadfastness. It is believed to bring blessings of prosperity, loyalty, and protection.
data.etymology: Gaffar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Trustworthy, Honest.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gaffar total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

The name is also associated with the protector deity of cattle and wealth, Lord Krishna, who was known as a cowherd in his youth.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Gaffar signifies protection and service to others. It signifies the divine masculine energies of nurturing, protecting, and caring for others, often represented by the figure of Lord Krishna. This name inspires one to live a life of honesty, goodness, and service to others, ultimately leading to spiritual growth and enlightenment.

In Hindu context, Gaffar represents an individual who strives to purify their mind and actions, offering service to the divine and humanity with an unselfish heart.
